entries.title: South Africa on edge with anti-migrant protests underway
entries.snippet: Anti-immigrant groups have set June 30 as an unofficial deadline for undocumented migrants to leave, with protests taking place across South Africa. Authorities say little violence has occurred so far. DW has more.
